payload.name: Cognitive Attraction in Misinformation Engagement
payload.fact: In the context of Facebook misinformation, videos and images are exceptionally strong predictors of engagement, particularly shares, while social information and threat-related information reduce engagement.
payload.boundary: Observed in the context of Danish Facebook posts identified as misleading.

provenance.title: Sharing, commenting, and reacting to Danish misinformation: A case study of cognitive attraction on Facebook
provenance.quote_or_locus: The study showed that videos and images were exceptionally strong predictors of engagement, especially shares. Positivity, negativity, and intergroup-related information also increased engagement, but social information and threat-related information reduced it
